title: Communication Is Not About Speaking, It's About Listening
coreMove: Say the claim first, then choose the visible action that can pay it back; if the audience reads a different ledger, more speech only adds noise.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a health claim read through the cart
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the return moment exposes the skipped move

exampleSpecs.audience: people tracing proof after a draft
exampleSpecs.stakes: a true detail moved to the wrong place
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the miss is caught late by tracing one loose detail

exampleSpecs.audience: customers downstream of a brand claim
exampleSpecs.stakes: a real identity mark flattened into generic proof
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: an outsider feels the generic stamp before proof returns

exampleSpecs.stakes: a third scene that must do new work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: an early signal is protected even though the claim gets smaller

exampleSpecs.audience: people moving a signal across organizations
exampleSpecs.stakes: a useful idea applied too widely
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the standard is stated, then the overreach is barely caught

exampleSpecs.audience: people making a small promise visible
exampleSpecs.stakes: a demand already made before proof exists
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the return is set while the proof remains open
